column1: # Smart Energy Meter — 4MB dev board OTA partition layout
# App partitions must align to 0x10000 (64KB) boundaries.
# app0 starts at 0x20000 — first valid 64KB boundary after otadata.
# 60KB gap between otadata end (0x11000) and app0 is unavoidable.
# Production 8MB board uses separate partitions.csv with 3MB slots.
